title: scutellaria scordiifolia var. polyphylla
intro: Scutellaria scordiifolia var. polyphylla, commonly known as Chinese skullcap, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Chinese skullcap include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Chinese skullcap include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
